item.title: Ask HN: How important is document category recognition in data classification?
item.summary: Classifying files based solely on presence of IDs, numbers and other regex patterns, from experience, leads to much false positives and negatives. A technical manual document with a 9 digit number could trigger a SSN pattern check and get wrongly classified as having personal data /Confidential. Personal data on a HR document would be treated differently from personal data on a customer list. Would identifying the document category (tech manual, customer list, employee record) be a good additional layer to classifier logic? I'm trying to build a non-AI, light model and embedding based classifier that can semantically understand documents, and like opinions on how useful such a thing would be.
